## Battle Cleric (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Male human cleric 4  
 CN Medium humanoid (human)  

**Init** +1; **Senses** Perception +5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 9, flat-footed 15 (+6 armor, –1 Dex)  

**hp** 42 (4d8+10)  

**Fort** +5, **Ref** +0, **Will** +6  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft.  

**Melee** mwk greatsword +7 (2d6+4/19–20)  

**Special Attacks** channel positive energy 4/day (DC 14, 2d6), destructive smite +2 (5/day)  

**Domain Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 4th, concentration +6)  
 5/day—strength surge +2  
 **Spells Prepared** (CL 4th, concentration +6)  
 2nd—*[bull’s strength](../../magic/spells/bulls-strength.md)*<sup>D</sup>, *[delay poison](../../magic/spells/delay-poison.md)*, *[lesser restoration](../../magic/spells/restoration-lesser.md)*, *[spiritual weapon](../../magic/spells/spiritual-weapon.md)*  

1st—*[divine favor](../../magic/spells/divine-favor.md)*, *[magic weapon](../../magic/spells/magic-weapon.md)*, *[remove fear](../../magic/spells/remove-fear.md)*, *[shield of faith](../../magic/spells/shield-of-faith.md)*, *[true strike](../../magic/spells/true-strike.md)*<sup>D</sup>  

0 (at will)—*[light](../../magic/spells/light.md)*, *[mending](../../magic/spells/mending.md)*, *[stabilize](../../magic/spells/stabilize.md)*, *[virtue](../../magic/spells/virtue.md)*  
  <sup>D</sup> Domain spell; **Domains** Destruction, Strength  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 17, **Dex** 9, **Con** 13, **Int** 13, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 12  

**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 15  

**Feats** Combat Casting, Toughness, Weapon Focus (greatsword)  

**Skills** Heal +8, Intimidate +4, Knowledge (local) +4, Knowledge (religion) +6, Perception +5  

**Languages** Abyssal, Common  

**Traits** Favored Son, Reactionary  

**SQ** aura, traits (Favored Son, Reactionary)  

**Gear** chainmail, masterwork greatsword, backpack, grappling hook, iron holy symbol, rope, sunrods (2), tindertwigs (2), torches (9), 195 gp
